Stay vigilant!.|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 4 (Formerly, [[Headache Headquarters]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Chad''' was an enemy that appeared [[Headache Headquarters]], replacing the [[Slow]]. Currently, it only appears when the [[Brain Rot]] modifier is activated in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, replacing every [[Slow]] and [[Heavy]] modern variant, or with its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]. It has a high amount of health and was slightly faster than the [[Toilet]], which makes it a quite dangerous enemy. Additionally, it has defense, reducing most forms of damage against it. ==Appearance== The '''Chad''' has grey skin, black pants, hair and beard. ==Headache Headquarters Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Headache Headquarters]] is listed instead. *Strong early-game towers like the [[Militant]], [[Golden Scout]] or [[Golden Cowboy]] are very effective here. **Towers with area of effect capabilities, like the [[Electroshocker]] or [[Mortar]], can also be useful here. **Towers that decrease defense, like the [[Pyromancer]], [[Electroshocker]] or [[Cryomancer]] can be used to allow your towers to deal more damage to them, as well as making them slower when affected by certain defense dropping towers. *High DPS towers, such as the [[Minigunner]] can be quite effective against this enemy, although they might cost a bit too much to be utilized when it first spawns. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1Chad.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseChad.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} ChadIconIG.png|'''Chad''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *This enemy was inspired by the [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/gigachad GigaChad] meme. *The '''Chad's''' appearance is the same as the Level 0 [[Minigunner]]'s {{Color|Premium|Chad}} skin, though it lacks its minigun. ==Update History== *'''1 April 2024''' -
